attchmntText: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited has informed the Exchange about change in authorization under Regulation 30(5) of SEBI(LODR)
sm_name: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited
voiceSummary: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board authorized Mr. Paramjit Singh Chadha, Managing Director, and Mr. Rakesh Mishra, Chief Financial Officer, to determine materiality and make disclosures. Ms. C V Kavviya, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, was also authorized for disclosures. The Risk Management Committee was reconstituted with immediate effect from 13th November 2026. Standalone revenue for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was 1,19,053.95 lakhs, with a profit after tax of 12,388.91 lakhs. For the six-month period, standalone revenue was 2,43,425.11 lakhs, and profit after tax was 22,299.04 lakhs. The statutory auditor's report is unqualified.

voiceSummary: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited has scheduled a conference call to discuss financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The event is organized by M/s. 360 ONE Capital Market Private Limited on November 23, 2026, at 14:30 hrs. IST. Management representatives including Managing Director Mr. Paramjit Singh Chadha, Chief Financial Officer Mr. Rakesh Mishra, and Head of OE Sales Mr. Shankar Venkatachalam will participate. The call is intended for fund managers, analysts, and investors.
